data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'far' (to be free, to release), Farya evokes the sense of liberation and freedom from constraints. This evocative name is cherished in Islamic cultures for its spiritual resonance and symbolic significance. The name Farya carries the meaning “Free, Liberated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farya usually hope their child will grow to embody free, liberated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
